java.lang.Object

   +----com.oroinc.net.nntp.NNTPCommand
public final class NNTPCommand
extends Object
NNTPCommand stores a set of constants for NNTP command codes. To interpret the meaning of the codes, familiarity with RFC 977 is assumed.
